projectDescription: A Chrome MV3 side-panel assistant that connects the browser to Codex through a local native bridge, enabling page context, tab management, voice input, image editing, and browser automation workflows.
keyFeatures: Chrome MV3 side-panel with chat-first UX connected to Codex via native messaging
Automatic context routing for current page, selected tabs, browser history, and files
20+ built-in AI profiles (YouTube Summarizer, Research Assistant, Fact Checker, Slide Maker, etc.)
Voice input with live transcription and real-time voice session support
Non-destructive image editing and generation via Codex image workflows
Site-aware adapters for YouTube, Gmail, arXiv, news, and more
Browser automation through DOM control scripts and Playwright
Multi-language UI with 15+ Chrome locale entries
@-picker for tab mentions and /-picker for profile selection
Attachment support for PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, XLSM, and image files
publicApiSurface: BridgeRpcRouter.handle(request, options) — routes all bridge RPC methods
prompt.send — send a prompt with context and file attachments
route.plan — agentic route planning for context and task selection
voice.session.start / voice.session.append_audio / voice.session.stop — voice session methods
profile.list / profile.select — built-in AI profile management
normalizeAgenticRoutePlan(rawPlan, input) — normalize agentic route plan from LLM output
createFallbackAgenticRoutePlan(input, reason) — create a fallback route plan
listProfileTemplates() — list all built-in profile templates
getProfileTemplate(id) — get a specific profile template by ID
